product_one_liner.value: Trusaic provides pay-equity and pay-transparency software that helps global enterprises make precise, compliant pay decisions and address pay inequities.
product_one_liner.notes: Trusaic describes software for global enterprises that helps make compliant pay decisions, achieve pay equity, and streamline pay-transparency reporting.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage footer shows resource and contact links but no pricing link; its sales/contact route is not a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer advisory board page names customer representatives and displays company names including Envista, Thomson Reuters, and Alaska Airlines. | named_customers.0: The customer advisory board page includes Envista. | named_customers.1: The customer advisory board page includes Thomson Reuters. | named_customers.2: The customer advisory board page includes Alaska Airlines.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 121 employees; that count falls in the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile lists Los Angeles as its location city, and the DPA refers to Trusaic’s Los Angeles headquarters. | hq_country: The Trusaic company profile identifies its location_country as United States.

founded_year.notes: The Trusaic company profile reports its founded_year as 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is organized around pay equity, pay transparency, AI, ACA compliance, and tax credits, and shows compliance-oriented articles rather than an engineering blog with multiple technical product-building posts.

public_docs.notes: The homepage footer links to resources and contact, but the navigation reviewed contains no product documentation, help center, or developer-portal link. Marketing resources do not constitute product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers listing page was accessible, but the page content reviewed did not expose actual open job titles or an explicit no-openings statement. The available evidence is insufficient to determine whether an AI, ML, or data-science role is open.

model_provider.notes: The DPA identifies Microsoft Azure as a cloud-hosting subprocessor, not as the AI model provider. The responsible-AI page says no public LLMs but does not name the underlying model or provider, so the model provider is unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company homepage trust-and-security section names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliant. The list includes only those named claims. | compliance_certs.0: The cited homepage trust section names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The same homepage trust section names ISO 27001 as certified. | compliance_certs.2: The same homepage trust section states GDPR compliant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The founder states there has been no outside funding, and the company profile lists no funding rounds. The latest funding stage is therefore none. | funding_date: The founder says Trusaic has not taken outside funding, and the company profile lists no funding rounds or latest-round date. No round date applies. | funding_amount_usd: The founder says Trusaic has not taken outside funding, and the company profile shows no funding rounds or latest-round amount. There is no funding amount to report.

raised_18mo.notes: The founder says there has been no outside funding, and the company profile shows no funding rounds; consequently, no funding was raised in the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job posting states that Trusaic is hiring a Global Enterprise Account Executive and invites applicants to apply.

launched_6mo.notes: Trusaic announced an enhancement to its EU Pay Transparency Directive monitor with an interactive map on May 20, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company team page lists its leaders. The LinkedIn profile date for Lynn Kaiser’s VP role is 2025-11-01, before the 12-month window beginning 2025-11-09; the reviewed leadership information does not show a qualifying join or announced departure within the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The account executive posting names HubSpot, Avoma, and ZoomInfo in its sales-pipeline requirements. | crm_stack_signal.0: The posting names HubSpot. | crm_stack_signal.1: The posting names Avoma. | crm_stack_signal.2: The posting names ZoomInfo.
